STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: origen_144050.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: origen_144050.v · Open raw
module origen_144050 (
    input wire clk,
    input wire resetn,
    input wire wen,
    input wire [1:0] input_sel,
    input wire input_valid,
    input wire [31:0] input_value,
    
    output reg led_wen,
    output reg [4:0] led_waddr,
    output reg [31:0] led_wdata,
    output reg [4:0] led_raddr1,
    output reg [4:0] led_raddr2,
    output reg lcd_rst,
    output reg lcd_cs,
    output reg lcd_rs,
    output reg lcd_wr,
    output reg lcd_rd,
    inout wire [15:0] lcd_data_io,
    output reg lcd_bl_ctr,
    input wire ct_int,
    inout wire ct_sda,
    output reg ct_scl,
    output reg ct_rstn
);

    reg [31:0] registers [0:31];
    reg [4:0] read_addr1, read_addr2, write_addr;
    reg [31:0] write_data;
    reg [2:0] lcd_state;
    reg [5:0] reg_index;
    reg [15:0] lcd_data_out;
    reg lcd_data_dir;

    always @(posedge clk or negedge resetn) begin
        if (!resetn) begin
            read_addr1 <= 5'b0;
            read_addr2 <= 5'b0;
            write_addr <= 5'b0;
            write_data <= 32'b0;
            led_wen <= 1'b0;
            led_waddr <= 5'b0;
            led_wdata <= 32'b0;
            led_raddr1 <= 5'b0;
            led_raddr2 <= 5'b0;
            lcd_state <= 3'b0;
            reg_index <= 6'b0;
            lcd_rst <= 1'b1;
            lcd_cs <= 1'b1;
            lcd_rs <= 1'b0;
            lcd_wr <= 1'b1;
            lcd_rd <= 1'b1;
            lcd_bl_ctr <= 1'b0;
            ct_scl <= 1'b1;
            ct_rstn <= 1'b0;
        end else begin
            if (input_valid) begin
                case (input_sel)
                    2'b00: read_addr1 <= input_value[4:0];
                    2'b01: read_addr2 <= input_value[4:0];
                    2'b10: write_addr <= input_value[4:0];
                    2'b11: write_data <= input_value;
                endcase
            end

            if (wen) begin
                registers[write_addr] <= write_data;
                led_wen <= 1'b1;
                led_waddr <= write_addr;
                led_wdata <= write_data;
            end else begin
                led_wen <= 1'b0;
            end

            led_raddr1 <= read_addr1;
            led_raddr2 <= read_addr2;

            case (lcd_state)
                3'b000: begin // Initialize LCD
                    lcd_rst <= 1'b0;
                    lcd_cs <= 1'b0;
                    lcd_state <= 3'b001;
                end
                3'b001: begin // Write command
                    lcd_rs <= 1'b0;
                    lcd_wr <= 1'b0;
                    lcd_data_dir <= 1'b1;
                    lcd_data_out <= 16'h0001; // Clear display
                    lcd_state <= 3'b010;
                end
                3'b010: begin // Write data
                    lcd_rs <= 1'b1;
                    lcd_wr <= 1'b0;
                    lcd_data_out <= registers[reg_index][31:16];
                    lcd_state <= 3'b011;
                end
                3'b011: begin // Write data
                    lcd_data_out <= registers[reg_index][15:0];
                    reg_index <= reg_index + 1;
                    if (reg_index == 6'b111111) begin
                        lcd_state <= 3'b100;
                    end else begin
                        lcd_state <= 3'b010;
                    end
                end
                3'b100: begin // Finish
                    lcd_cs <= 1'b1;
                    lcd_bl_ctr <= 1'b1;
                    lcd_state <= 3'b101;
                end
                default: lcd_state <= 3'b101;
            endcase

            ct_rstn <= 1'b1;
        end
    end

    assign lcd_data_io = lcd_data_dir ? lcd_data_out : 16'bz;

endmodule
